claims.value: Suchet claims side B received 4,000 Valencian troops overnight; this is a reinforcement estimate, not the total present.
claims.rationale: French opponent claim; Toreno describes mixed arrivals and losses without a matching numeric total in the checked pages. English rendering (ours): "Blake, reinforced overnight by four thousand Valencian troops, had positioned himself on the Belchite heights."

claims.rationale: Local delegated task within Suchet’s direction, not equal automatic credit. English rendering (ours): "Musnier was ordered to move in battalion columns and charge once artillery had shaken the line."

claims.rationale: The paragraph continues centre and left dispositions; this is deployment authority, not proof of continuous control. English rendering (ours): "Blake placed his right on Calvario, the hill behind Belchite."
